items.topic: 交易隐私：LUCID 同 slot 解密
items.title: ethresear.ch：LUCID 同 slot 解密，可选 N 执行加 N+1 回落
items.note: （murat）00:26：LUCID 在提交后的下一个 slot 解密，因为 builder 的承诺位于信标区块内，slot 结束前无法观察；builder 须先承诺后见明文，解密方须先见承诺才放出密钥，slot 边界解开了这个循环，但代价约 12 秒延迟，文章提出可选的同 slot 执行。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Same-Slot Decryption for LUCID, optional N execution with N+1 fallback
items.note_en: (murat), 00:26: LUCID decrypts in the slot after submission because the builder's commitment sits inside the beacon block and cannot be seen before the slot ends; builders must commit before seeing plaintext and decryptors must see the commitment before releasing keys, and the slot boundary breaks that loop at a cost of about 12 seconds, so the post proposes optional same slot execution.

summary_en: An ethresear.ch post proposed same slot decryption for LUCID: optional execution in slot N with fallback to N+1, saving about 12 seconds. chunter-cb updated EIP-8130 nonce and EOA delegation rules, submitted and merged. zacksfF submitted the Hash-Committed Account EIP. Nethermind published distributed verification for post-quantum blobs. After the Drift hack, hasufl and others called for circuit breakers and timelocks across DeFi.
